item.title: 4 Hunting Towers Destroyed in Memory of Imanali Nurakan (Opole Lubelskie, Poland)
item.description: Received anonymously: Hunt saboteur activists destroyed 4 hunting towers to commemorate the death of Imanali Nurakan, a 16 years old exchange student. He was killed by a drunk local hunter exactly 5 years ago. The hunter was sentenced to 4 years 9 month of prison time and he already served it. No other hunting club … Continue reading

item.title: 3 Hunting Towers Destroyed (South Germany)
item.description: Received anonymously: 3 hunting towers tired. 3 hunting towers asleep!

item.title: 50 Chickens Liberated from Koporos Slaughter in Brooklyn (New York, USA)
item.description: Received anonymously: 50 chickens liberated under the cover of the night, hours before being slaughtered during the ritual of Kaporos that takes place in the streets of Brooklyn every year. Be the resistance, go out, liberate animals, fight back!

item.title: 3 Activists Murdered in India for Opposing Cow Slaughter
item.description: Lalit Jain was an advocate and associated with Bajrang Dal, the youth wing of the Vishva Hindu Parishad. Jain was an activist against State illegal cow slaughter, he was on his way to attend proceedings related to a case about illegal cow slaughter. He was waylaid by assailants in an auto rickshaw, three rounds were fired at him … Continue reading

item.title: Rich Valley Furs Re-opens on former Lion Farms site (Ohio, USA)
item.description: Rich Valley Furs has officially opened on the former Lion Farms property in Ohio (2707 Hoaglin Rd, Van Wert, OH 45891), bringing mink farming back to the area following the previous facility’s closure. Much of the experienced management team is staying on, providing stability and day-to-day expertise. The new owners plan to modernize operations with … Continue reading

item.title: Gengel Mink Farm in Lake Villa, Illinois Has Closed (USA)
item.description: After 65 years in operation, and the slaughter of too many mink to count, we can confirm that the Gengel Mink Farm in Lake Villa, Illinois has closed.
